milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the white bed at spawn-relative (+6, 0, +6) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. Target is the bed head position. max_distance=16 allows detection from moderate range, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the bed.

Uses inventory_has because mining a white tulip causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. White tulips break instantly by hand (no tool required) and drop themselves. The tulip is not in the starting inventory, so having one confirms it was mined.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a stone pressure plate (2 stone in a row on crafting table) produces the item in the player's inventory. The player starts with 4 stone and no pressure plates, so having a stone_pressure_plate confirms successful crafting. Stone is explicitly provided for this recipe.

Uses inventory_has because crafting spruce slabs (3 spruce_planks in a row on crafting table) produces 6 spruce_slabs in the player's inventory. The player starts with 6 spruce planks and no slabs, so having spruce_slabs confirms successful crafting. min_count=6 matches exactly one recipe output (3 planks → 6 slabs).
